item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's class visited a village near a forest in Kerala. Her teacher asked, "How do ecosystems like this forest benefit people?"
Which statement best explains how ecosystems benefit humans?

options.A: Ecosystems benefit humans only when people build farms or factories on the land.
options.B: Ecosystems benefit humans only by giving wood for making furniture.
options.C: Ecosystems benefit humans because living and non-living parts depend on each other and provide services such as fresh air, clean water and fertile soil.
options.D: Ecosystems do not benefit humans because natural processes happen without people.
